spec.description: VF-014 in verification/findings.md: job 20261107-041414 compared the own checker's benchmark runs at step H1 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md (symbolic references, change uyqkxsly, commit ddbb54ba) with a stale lib/benchmark/results.json, so 8 verdicts changed for reasons it couldn't tell apart from H1. Jobs 20261107-164450-vf-014-h1-isolated-run-1-of-2-the-benchm (at H1's parent b927e5df) and -run-2-of-2- (at H1, ddbb54ba) ran that job's step 1 unchanged and both passed; their lib/target/benchmark-native.json files are kept, gitignored, under verification/results/ID/outputs/ in the runner's repository, not in this checkout. This job finds them there (four directories above $VERIFY_WORKDIR), checks each against the sha256 its run recorded, and applies 20261107-041414's step-2 comparison script unchanged except that it reads run 1's file in place of lib/benchmark/results.json and run 2's in place of lib/target/benchmark-native.json. It exits 1 if any own-checker verdict differs between H1's parent and H1, 2 if the outputs are missing or not the recorded ones. Tried on the same files before submitting: 557 runs at H1, 24 new (the swaps, swapsOrNull and swapsThenNull cases H1 added, in three modes), 0 verdicts changed, 0 formulas grown past 10%, 0 paths or merges changed. Closes VF-014 when it passes.
spec.expected: exits 0: every own-checker verdict at H1 is the one at H1's parent; the only new runs are the 24 of the swaps cases H1 added; the summary line reads 'verdicts changed: 0'
